# codec class

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:codecClass`](gmeow-codecClass.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/codecClass>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)

The capability class of a transform codec (spec §8): what a reader must hold to reverse it — a library (encode, compress) or a key (encrypt).
